summary: Trulieve Cannabis Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program. The company may repurchase up to the lesser of $50 million aggregate value or 8,495,038 subordinate voting shares (5% of outstanding) over 12 months, expiring June 16, 2027. Repurchases will follow applicable securities laws; no specific number is obligated and the program may be suspended or discontinued at discretion. Purchased shares will be cancelled. The program signals management's confidence in intrinsic value and disciplined capital allocation. Watch for actual buyback execution pace and potential impacts on share float and EPS.
